servicios.title: Services
servicios.lede: Pick what you need. If you are not sure where to start, tell me the problem and we will work it out together.

items.texto: Network installation and setup. Wi‑Fi that reaches every room of your home or office: routers, extenders, mesh systems, cabling and security.
Custom applications for your business: websites, mobile apps, internal systems and automation of repetitive tasks.
Assistants and automations powered by artificial intelligence to answer customers, organize documents and save hours of work.
Patient guidance to use the phone, WhatsApp, video calls and online services, and to spot scams.
Security cameras you can watch from your phone, with recording and alerts. I help you choose the right equipment for your space.
Smart home setup: lights, plugs, voice assistants and automatic routines you control from your phone.

pasos.texto: By WhatsApp or a call. No jargon: describe the problem in your own words.
I review your case and propose a solution with a fixed price before starting.
I install it, test it with you and show you how to use it. I stay available for questions.

contacto.title: Shall we talk?
contacto.texto: Message me and I will reply the same day. The diagnosis costs CLP $10,000 and is free if you approve the quote.
